title: helichrysum roseum var. patens
intro: Helichrysum roseum var. patens, commonly known as Everlasting Daisy, is a flowering plant species that belongs to the Asteraceae family. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits such as reducing inflammation, relieving pain, and promoting wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Helichrysum roseum var. patens include antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its potential use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and volatile oils, particularly 1,8-cineole, which are responsible for its therapeutic properties.
